package scoping

fun outer(total: Int): Int {
    var total2 = total
    val items = listOf(1, 2, 3)
    for (item in items) {
        val total = item * 2
        total2 += total
    }
    items.forEach { item -> total2 += item }
    try {
        total2 /= 0
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        total2 = -1
    }
    return total2
}

enum class Level(val weight: Int) {
    LOW(1), HIGH(2)
}

data class Point(val x: Int, val y: Int)

fun Point.shift(dx: Int): Point = Point(x + dx, y)
